description: PHOENIX – Today, Katie Hobbs, in conjunction with the Navajo County Democratic Committee, launched “Forward,” putting the choice facing Arizona voters in focus: a governor who has worked across the aisle to deliver results, or a Washington politician who has made life more expensive for Arizona’s working families. “Forward” showcases Hobbs’ record of bringing people together […]
paid_for_by: Paid for by Elect Katie Hobbs
title: Katie Hobbs Launches New TV Ad, “Forward,” Showcasing Her Continued Commitment To Working Together To Move Arizona Forward - Katie Hobbs for Governor
